title: Isolation of exosomal RNA from serum or plasma using the New England Peptide ME<sup>TM</sup> kit
protocol: Reconstitute the Vn96 peptide to 2.5 µg/µL by adding 200 µL ME-buffer.
Transfer 500 µL of serum or plasma into a 1.5 mL microfuge tube.
Add 500 µL PBS to the tube.
Centrifuge for 7 minutes at 10,000 x g at room temperature to remove debris.
Transfer supernatant to fresh tube, avoiding any pelleted material.
Add 20 µL reconstituted Vn96 peptide (use same amount of Vn96-Scr as a negative control).
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes on a rotator.
Centrifuge for 7 minutes at 10,000 x g at room temperature to pellet extracellular vesicles.
Wash by adding 1 mL PBS + 5 µL protease inhibitor cocktail, inverting 10 times.
Centrifuge for 7 minutes at 10,000 x g at room temperature.
Repeat washing step with PBS + protease inhibitor cocktail.
Isolate RNA using miRNeasy micro kit.
